annotations.title: Storm History by Address: Reported and Radar-Detected Events Since 2003

description: ONE PROPERTY, 2003 TO PRESENT. Storm History by Address: Reported and Radar-Detected Events Since 2003. Use when the user wants the full citable record for a single address, or a date-of-loss lookup: 11 event categories (hail, wind, flood, lightning, tornado, hurricane, winter storm, extreme heat/cold, drought, wildfire, coastal) in one report. Input is a street address or lat/lon. Not the 365-day snapshot (use get_address_report) and not a county summary (use get_storm_history). Without a key, returns the exact price quote (report-line count and price) and a pay link; with a key (or x402 payment) it returns the data. Paid report: $0.05 per line, no minimum (zero matching lines = $0.05). Optional date_of_loss anchors the report around one date and lists the events reported or radar-detected on and around it, for reference; it is not a determination of whether any claim is valid. Address and date of loss are sent in a POST body, which keeps them out of URLs and logs.

address.description: Street address. Server-side geocoding, no separate geocoding step needed.

addresses.description: false = price quote (line count + price) and pay link. true = the full report ($0.05/line, no minimum; requires an Atlas United Data API key or an x402 payment).

date_of_loss.description: Optional, YYYY-MM-DD. Anchors the report around this date.

radius_mi.description: Search radius in miles. Default 5, max 25.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment payload, used instead of an API key.
